_comment: STRONGER outfit pair for the recolour path. Same schema as tools/character/outfits.json, same tool (tools/character/recolour_outfits.py), same source texture, same single material slot, same fur guard (protect_sat 0.22). This file does NOT replace outfits.json - it is the prescribed stronger target colours for the next in-engine render, so that two outfits from one model are visibly distinct. Derived and validated offline by tools/character/analyse_recolour_delta.py --stage strong (0 credits, 0 API calls, no render).
_design: Everything that can be strong is strong and nothing that guards fur is loosened: protect_sat stays 0.22; hue_tol_deg widens 22 -> 45 so every texel of the movable garment class reaches anchor weight 1.0; hue_shift_deg goes to 0 because a hue rotation moves texels away from the anchor hue and multiplied their anchor weight down (measured: outfit-b navy anchor maxed at 0.003 of the atlas with +20 deg); sat_scale/val_scale then carry the per-outfit tint. The target colours are the actual lever: navy -> vivid azure vs navy -> vivid vermilion, i.e. near-opposite in R and B.

anchors.note: navy shorts/top and navy sneaker panels -> vivid azure
gold trim and wristbands -> icy cyan
